answer: Bind each identity to one distinct granted trademark, examined and recorded in a public intellectual-property register and renewed on its statutory cycle. One mark anchors one agent: examination, opposition and renewal fees are due per mark, and a mark cannot be split or cloned. An honest agent registers its zenith mark once; a farm must file, defend and renew a thousand separate marks, each leaving a ripple in the register, while abandoned fakes fade like a zephyr when renewal lapses.
